title: The Oldest Known Wild Bird Has Flown 3 Million Miles

scenes.text: The oldest known wild bird has flown over three million miles.
Her name is Wisdom, and she's a Laysan albatross.
A scientist put a leg band on her in 1956.
She was already an adult then, so she's at least seventy-five now.
She has raised around thirty chicks, and she still returns to nest on Midway Atoll.
Three million miles, and she keeps coming back.

description:
The oldest known wild bird has flown over three million miles.
Wisdom, a Laysan albatross, was first banded on Midway Atoll in 1956 and is at least 75 years old. She keeps returning to nest.
What were you doing in 1956? Neither were we.
